name: Atari 2600
description: The console that brought arcade gaming into living rooms and defined the early home video game market.

name: Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
description: An 8-bit console that revived the video game industry after the 1983 crash and launched Mario and Zelda.

name: Sega Mega Drive / Genesis
description: A 16-bit console famous for fast-paced action games and the rivalry between Sonic and Mario.

name: Game Boy
description: A rugged handheld with a monochrome screen and long battery life that made portable gaming mainstream.

name: Super Nintendo (SNES)
description: A 16-bit console praised for its colourful graphics, sound quality and a legendary library of classics.

name: PlayStation (PS1)
description: Sony's first console, which brought 3D gaming and CD-based games to a massive audience.

name: Nintendo 64
description: Nintendo's first 3D console, known for its four controller ports and groundbreaking 3D platformers.

name: Sega Dreamcast
description: Sega's final console, ahead of its time with built-in online features and arcade-quality games.

name: PlayStation 2 (PS2)
description: The best-selling console of all time, with a huge library spanning almost every genre.

name: Game Boy Advance (GBA)
description: A 32-bit handheld with a colour screen that brought SNES-quality games on the go.
